baselineDisplay.title: 一个糟心的上午
baselineDisplay.text:
【故事复现】一个糟心的上午
• Step 1: Listen and answer the question.
第一步：听 Freya 慢速朗读的故事，回答下列问题。
Question: What two interruptions did the writer have?
问题：作者怎么被打断了两次？
• 词汇准备
• sticky 粘的
• finger 手指
• pie 馅饼
• mix 混合，拌和
• pastry 面糊
• annoying 恼人的
• receiver 电话的话筒
• dismay 使失望，使泄气
• recognize 认出，听出
• persuade 说服，劝说
• mess 乱七八糟
• doorknob 门把手
• sign 签字
• register 挂号邮寄
• Step 2: Intensive reading.
第二步：故事精读。
After breakfast, I sent the children to school and then I went to the shops.
早饭后，我送孩子们上学，然后就去了商店。
It was still early when I returned home. The children were at school, my husband was at work and the house was quiet.
我回到家时，时间还早。孩子们在上学，我丈夫在上班，家里清静得很。
So, I decided to make some meat pies. In a short time, I was busy mixing butter and flour and my hands were soon covered with sticky pastry.
于是我决定做些肉馅饼。不一会儿我就忙着调拌起了黄油和面粉，很快我的手上就沾满了粘粘的面糊。
At exactly that moment, the telephone rang. Nothing could have been more annoying.
恰恰在此时，电话铃响了。没有什么能比这更烦人了。
I picked up the receiver between two sticky fingers and was dismayed when I recognized the voice of Helen Bates.
我用两个沾满面糊的手指捏起了话筒。当听出是海伦·贝茨的声音时，非常失望。
It took me ten minutes to persuade her to ring back later. At last, I hung up the receiver.
我用了 10 分钟的时间才说服她过会儿再来电话。我终于挂上了话筒。
What a mess! There was pastry on my fingers, on the telephone, and on the doorknobs.
真是糟糕透了!我的手指上、电话机上以及门的把手上，都沾上了面糊。
I had no sooner got back to the kitchen than the doorbell rang loud enough to wake up the dead.
我刚回到厨房，门铃又响了起来，响声足以把死人唤醒。
This time it was the postman and he wanted me to sign for a registered letter!
这次是邮递员，他要我签收一封挂号信!
• Step 3: Listen again and answer the questions.
第三步：再听一遍，回答下列问题。
1 Did the writer return home from the shops or not? What did she begin to make? (As soon as)
2 Did the telephone ring soon afterwards or not? Were her fingers very sticky or not? (When)
3 How long did she spend talking to Helen Bates on the telephone?
4 Did she look at the mess she had made or not? (After that)
5 What was covered with pastry?
6 Who rang the doorbell? (Just then)
7 What did he want her to do?
Answer: As soon as the writer returned home from the shops, she began to make some meat pies. When the telephone rang soon afterwards, her fingers were very sticky. She spent ten minutes talking to Helen Bates on the telephone. After that she looked at the mess she had made. Her fingers, the telephone and the doorknobs were covered with pastry. Just then the postman rang the doorbell. He wanted her to sign for a registered letter.
• Exercise: Sentence structure and vocabulary.
课外练习：句型及词汇训练。
1. The telephone rang _________.
(a) at a convenient time
(b) when the house was empty,
(c) when the tarts were in the oven
(d) at an inconvenient time
2 Everything got into mess because _________.
(a) the writer was making meat pies
(b) the writer was interrupted several times while making meat pies
(c) the writer answered the telephone
(d) the writer opened the front door
3 _________ breakfast is the first meal of the day.
(a) The
(b) A
(c) This
(d) --
4 She returned home. She was ________ home all morning.
(a) to
(b) at
(c) ir
(d) on
5 Nothing could have been more annoying. It was ________ annoying thing that could have happened.
(a) the more
(b) more
(c) most
(d) the most
6 Whose voice did she recognize? Helen ________.
(a) Bate's
(b) Bates'
(c) Bates
(d) Bate
7 She had hardly got back to the kitchen ________ the doorbell rang.
(a) when
(b) than
(c) as
(d) as soon as
8 She was busy mixing butter and flour. She was ________.
(a) joining them
(b) uniting them
(c) unifying them
(d) putting them together
9 Pastry is as sticky as ________.
(a) ink
(b) water)
(c) glue
(d) flour
10 She was dismayed when she heard Helen Bates. She felt _________.
(a) pity
(b) sorry
(c) ill
(d) tired
11 She hung up the receiver. This means she ________.
(a) let it hang
(b) didn't put it back
(c) held it
(d) put it back in its place
12 She has just _________ up the receiver.
(a) hanged
(b) hang
(c) hanging
(d) hung
Key: 1 d 2 b 3 d 4 b 5 d 6 b 7 a 8 d 9 c 10 b 11 d 12 d
第四十三单元【语法点拨】 关系代词引导的定语从句
在主从复合句中起定语作用的从句称为定语从句。定语从句的作用是限制、描绘或说明主句中的某一单词、短语、另一从句或整个主句。
定语从句由关系代词、关系限定词或关系副词引导。学习定语从句的关键就是要区分和掌握关系代词、关系限定词和关系副词。
• 现将关系代词及其指代关系列表如下：
关系代词的格
主格形式，指人：用于限制性定语从句 that, as；用于限制性或非限制性定语从句 who。
主格形式，指物：用于限制性定语从句 that, as；用于限制性或非限制性定语从句 which, as。
宾格形式，指人：用于限制性定语从句 that, as；用于限制性或非限制性定语从句 who, whom。
宾格形式，指物：用于限制性定语从句 that, as；用于限制性或非限制性定语从句 which, as。
所有格形式，指人：用于限制性或非限制性定语从句 whose (=of whom)。
所有格形式，指物：用于限制性或非限制性定语从句 whose (=of which)。
名词性关系限定词有：what, whatever, which, whichever，指人指物均可。关系副词有：when, where, why
▶ 关系代词引导的定语从句
▪ 关系代词在从句中作主语
➢ 限制性定语从句的关系代词是 who, that, which, that 指人指物均可。习惯上多用 who 指人, which 只能指物。关系代词在定语从句作主语时，从句谓语动词的人称和数要与先行词保持一致。
• Is he the man who/ that wants to see you? 他就是想见你的人吗?
• She is the woman who/ that lives next door. 她就是住在隔壁的那个妇女。
• There is still a big problem that/which has not been solved.
还有一个尚未解决的大问题。
➢ 作非限制性定语从句主语的关系代词是 who(指人)和 which(指物)，决不可用 that。
• She has two daughters, who are college students in Beijing.
她有两个女儿，在北京读大学。
• This book, which appeared only a year ago, has already gone through several editions.
这本仅一年前才问世的书已经经历了好几个版本。
▪ 关系代词在从句中作动词或介词的宾语
➢ 在限制性定语从句中，作动词宾语的关系代词 whom 用来指人，用 who 指人是非正式用法，在某些考试(如 TOEFL 考试)中被视为错误。用 that 也可指人，可与 who(m)换用， which 只能指物。
• Do you know the man whom/who/ that our dean is interviewing now?
你认识我们的系主任现在正在面谈的那个人吗?
• Where is the book that/which I bought yesterday?
我昨天买的那本书在哪里?
在非正式文体中,用作宾语的关系代词 whom, who, that 和 which 通常省略。在正式文体中，whom, who, that 和 which 不可省略。
➢ 在非限制性定语从句中，只能用 whom 指人，用 which 指物，不可用 that。
• Mr. Smith, whom you met with, has left for home.
你会见过的史密斯先生已经离开回国了。
➢ 关系代词作介词宾语,不论在限制性定语从句还是在非限制性定语从句中，当介词前置时，只能用 whom 指人，which 指物，决不可用 who 或 that。
• The headmaster, with whom the parents had discussed their son’s future, advised the boy to take up engineering.
家长与之讨论过他们儿子前途的这位校长劝告孩子选择工程学。
• This is the refrigerator with which we have so much trouble.
这就是我们遇到了这么多麻烦的那台电冰箱。
但当介词后置时，就没有这种限制。
• They are the boys whom/ that I went to school with.
他们就是我曾经与之一道上学的那些男孩。

常用关系代词：
指人：who 可作主语或宾语，whom 作宾语，whose 表示所属关系。
指物：which 可作主语或宾语，whose 也可表示所属关系。
that 可指人或物，用于限制性定语从句，作主语或宾语。
as 用于 such ... as、the same ... as 等特殊结构，也可在补充性从句中回指前述情况，不能在上述位置任意替换其他关系词。
whose 后接名词；用 of whom/of which 改写时通常需要相应调整整个名词短语的词序。
关系副词常见 when、where、why。what、whatever、whichever 等引出的名词性结构不等于修饰已有先行词的普通定语从句，须另行区分。
▶ 关系代词引导的定语从句
▪ 关系代词在从句中作主语
➢ 限制性定语从句的关系代词是 who, that, which, that 指人指物均可。习惯上多用 who 指人, which 只能指物。关系代词在定语从句作主语时，从句谓语动词的人称和数要与先行词保持一致。
• Is he the man who/ that wants to see you? 他就是想见你的人吗?
• She is the woman who/ that lives next door. 她就是住在隔壁的那个妇女。
• There is still a big problem that/which has not been solved.
还有一个尚未解决的大问题。
➢ 作非限制性定语从句主语的关系代词是 who(指人)和 which(指物)，决不可用 that。

她有两个女儿，在北京读大学。

你认识我们的系主任现在正在面谈的那个人吗?

我昨天买的那本书在哪里?

• This is the refrigerator with which we have so much trouble.
这就是我们遇到了这么多麻烦的那台电冰箱。

blocks.text: 【故事复现】一个糟心的上午
• Step 1: Listen and answer the question.
第一步：听 Freya 慢速朗读的故事，回答下列问题。
Question: What two interruptions did the writer have?
问题：作者做馅饼时受到哪两次打扰？
• 词汇准备
• sticky 粘的
• finger 手指
• pie 馅饼
• mix 混合，拌和
• pastry 做馅饼等用的面团；油酥面团
• annoying 恼人的
• receiver 电话的话筒
• dismay 使失望，使泄气
• recognize 认出，听出
• persuade 说服，劝说
• mess 乱七八糟
• doorknob 门把手
• sign 签字
• register 挂号邮寄
• Step 2: Intensive reading.
第二步：故事精读。

After breakfast, I sent the children to school and then I went to the shops.
早饭后，我送孩子们上学，然后就去了商店。

It was still early when I returned home. The children were at school, my husband was at work and the house was quiet.
我回到家时，时间还早。孩子们在上学，我丈夫在上班，家里清静得很。

So, I decided to make some meat pies. In a short time, I was busy mixing butter and flour and my hands were soon covered with sticky pastry.
于是我决定做些肉馅饼。不一会儿我就忙着调拌起了黄油和面粉，很快我的手上就沾满了粘粘的面团。

At exactly that moment, the telephone rang. Nothing could have been more annoying.
恰恰在此时，电话铃响了。没有什么能比这更烦人了。

I picked up the receiver between two sticky fingers and was dismayed when I recognized the voice of Helen Bates.
我用两个沾满面团的手指捏起了话筒。当听出是海伦·贝茨的声音时，非常失望。

It took me ten minutes to persuade her to ring back later. At last, I hung up the receiver.
我用了 10 分钟的时间才说服她过会儿再来电话。我终于挂上了话筒。

What a mess! There was pastry on my fingers, on the telephone, and on the doorknobs.
真是糟糕透了!我的手指上、电话机上以及门的把手上，都沾上了面团。

I had no sooner got back to the kitchen than the doorbell rang loud enough to wake up the dead.
我刚回到厨房，门铃又响了起来，响声足以把死人唤醒。

This time it was the postman and he wanted me to sign for a registered letter!
这次是邮递员，他要我签收一封挂号信!
• Step 3: Listen again and answer the questions.
第三步：再听一遍，回答下列问题。
1 Did the writer return home from the shops or not? What did she begin to make? (As soon as)
2 Did the telephone ring soon afterwards or not? Were her fingers very sticky or not? (When)
3 How long did she spend talking to Helen Bates on the telephone?
4 Did she look at the mess she had made or not? (After that)
5 What was covered with pastry?
6 Who rang the doorbell? (Just then)
7 What did he want her to do?

Answer: As soon as the writer returned home from the shops, she began to make some meat pies. When the telephone rang soon afterwards, her fingers were very sticky. She spent ten minutes talking to Helen Bates on the telephone. After that she looked at the mess she had made. Her fingers, the telephone and the doorknobs were covered with pastry. Just then the postman rang the doorbell. He wanted her to sign for a registered letter.
• Exercise: Sentence structure and vocabulary.
